item.title: Huxford Symphony Orchestra concert brings together students, community through music
item.description: The Huxford Symphony Orchestra played a concert in Moody Music Hall on Thursday night. item.title: SGA, ISA to offer Ramadan boxes
item.description: The SGA and International Student Association will offer meal boxes for students observing Ramadan. Ramadan is a Muslim holiday observed during the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, Feb. 17 to March 19. It is observed by fasting, prayer and reflection. item.title: Evolution Working Group hosts seminar on the evolutionary role of gossip
item.description: Talking bad about your friends actually does have effects on you, according to Nicole Hess, a professor of anthropology at Washington State University. item.title: Tuscaloosa man dies in police custody
item.description: A 33-year-old man died in police custody early Saturday morning. item.description: Alternative indie-pop singer Claire Rosinkranz released her second album, “My Lover,” on Friday, experimenting musically as she develops a coming of age story that explores her perspectives on love, death, family and nature.
